title: Toy Shop Choices
learning_objectives: Make a choice when you can't buy everything

events.description: You walk into the toy shop with $5. You see three toys on the shelf.

choices.label: Teddy Bear
choices.effect: You buy the teddy bear and have $2 left.

choices.label: Toy Car
choices.effect: You buy the toy car and have $3 left.

choices.label: Puzzle
choices.effect: You buy the puzzle and have $1 left.

events.description: Your friend asks if you want to share a snack that costs $2. Do you have enough money left?

choices.label: Yes, share the snack!
choices.effect: You share a snack with your friend. What a kind choice!

choices.label: No thanks, I'll save my money
choices.effect: You decide to save your money for later. Smart thinking!

recap_template: Today you visited the toy shop and learned about making choices with money. You started with $5 and practiced comparing prices.
positive_framing_rules: Never say a choice was wrong or bad
Praise the student for thinking about their decision
Frame saving and spending as both valid choices
ai_variation_allowed: Add extra dialogue from the shopkeeper
Describe the toys in more detail
Add a surprise bonus event if the student saved money

title: Lemonade Stand
learning_objectives: Understand earning money by selling something

events.description: You set up a lemonade stand in your front yard! Each cup of lemonade sells for $1. A neighbor walks up and wants to buy some.

choices.label: Sell 1 cup
choices.effect: You sell one cup and earn $1!

choices.label: Sell 2 cups
choices.effect: You sell two cups and earn $2!

choices.label: Give a free sample
choices.effect: You give a free sample. The neighbor smiles and tells their friends!

events.description: After selling lemonade all morning, you have some money. The ice cream truck is coming! An ice cream costs $3.

choices.label: Buy ice cream
choices.effect: You enjoy a cold ice cream on a hot day!

choices.label: Save your money
choices.effect: You put your money in your piggy bank. Great saving!

choices.label: Buy more lemons to sell
choices.effect: You buy more lemons to make more lemonade tomorrow!

recap_template: Today you ran a lemonade stand and learned about earning and spending money. Great job being a young entrepreneur!
positive_framing_rules: Never say a choice was wrong or bad
Celebrate both earning and spending decisions
ai_variation_allowed: Add extra customers with different requests
Vary the weather to affect sales
Add a surprise event like a dog visiting the stand
